draft.subject: Your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I wanted to check in and see how things are looking on your side.

Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the easiest way to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and get your first project set up together
